name: push up to knee tap
description: A push up where you pull a knee toward your elbow after each rep. It adds a core challenge to a standard push up.
instructions: Start in a push up position with a straight body.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
Bring one knee toward the same side elbow.
Return the foot and repeat on the other side.
Keep your hips level and your core braced.
